name: Steve Novick

verification_summary.balance_notes: Race portland-council-d3 (21 candidates). Every candidate was searched in the same shared sources: the Mercury (2026-09-09), OPB (2026-10-07), the Tribune Q&A (2026-10-13), the Multnomah pamphlet and the 2026 AUD-120 forms. Novick has 5 bio and 8 position items (T1 council page and pamphlet, T3). The AUD-120 text has no candidate fields. One statement was corrected. His pronouns are He/Him. The website novickforportland.com is printed in the pamphlet. Incumbent=true confirmed.
